name: Bas-Relief
description: Low, sculpted projection from a flat surface. Ideal for 2.5D grayscale carving. White = raised, black = recessed.
carving_traits: Good for portraits, coins, and flowing detail
Prefers smooth Z gradients and silhouette clarity
Carves well with ball nose and fine stepover
machinability_prompt: Render this as a grayscale heightmap for CNC bas-relief carving. White represents raised areas, black represents recessed. Background must be flat black. Avoid lighting effects, shadows, and textures.
